channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli attacks on Gaza kill seven as ‘ceasefire’ violations continue
item.description: At least six people killed in drone attack on passenger van and one person killed in strike on residential apartment.

item.title: ‘Economic war’: Is Iran losing its leverage over the Strait of Hormuz?
item.description: Crude flows through Hormuz have recovered, but tanker insurance costs and geopolitical risks remain barriers to a return to normality.

item.title: Russian attacks on Ukraine’s Kyiv region kill four, target power grid
item.description: City officials say three killed in Ukraine's capital, as emergency services say child killed in the surrounding region.

item.title: What’s behind French student protests that turned violent?
item.description: The school protests coincide with public sector strikes over planned budget cuts.

item.title: What we know about the Dubai-Israel plane incident after reported stabbing
item.description: The Saudi Arabian airport where the FlyDubai plane was diverted to said the captain and first officer were injured.

item.title: Girl has multiple surgeries to control infections after strike in Gaza
item.description: Witnesses say Raseel's tent was hit by an Israeli helicopter strike. Israel’s military says it has no record of the attack.

item.title: Somali pirates killed oil tanker crew before rescue, official tells BBC
item.description: Piracy off the Somali coast has increased in recent years after dropping when international naval operations began in 2011.
